target.title: fix(ios): chat composer stays a single line while typing multiline messages
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where the message input in the iOS app's Chat tab would stay a single line no matter how much text was typed, scrolling its content instead of growing like a normal chat composer.

## Why This Change Was Made

The composer's `TextField` was already configured to grow (`axis: .vertical`, `lineLimit(1...4)`), but the message list above it has `layoutPriority(1)`, so SwiftUI compressed the composer to its one-line minimum height and it could never expand. Adding `fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)` to the composer on iOS lets it size to its content, and the Talk button is now bottom-aligned (with an inset preserving its exact resting position) so it stays put while the field grows.

## User Impact

The Chat composer now expands upward as you type, up to 4 lines, then scrolls internally; the bar's background grows to fit and the Talk/send buttons stay pinned to the bottom. At one line of text the composer is pixel-identical to before.

## Evidence

- Reproduced and verified in the iOS 26.5 simulator layout: before the change the pill stays pinned at ~40pt with text overflowing; after, it grows to the line limit with the bottom edge anchored. Attached screen recording.
- `swift build --triple arm64-apple-ios18.0-simulator --target OpenClawChatUI` compiles clean; `swift test --filter ChatDynamicTypeSourceGuardTests` passes (it guards this exact modifier stack, including `fixedSize` and `lineLimit(1...4)`).
- Pre-existing `ChatViewModelTests` async-timeout failures reproduce identically on a clean tree without this diff (environment-related, untouched surface).
- I ran pnpm native:i18n:sync, verified pnpm native:i18n:check now passes clean
